atoms.html: For this week, my main goal is to make the particles look more fluid and to add some variants to the flow's edges. This is the first version of my particle flows. I tried to add more noise to achieve this, but the result was not satisfactory—they looked too messy. In the second shot, I adjusted the thickness of the final flow and modified the settings for the wind and PopcurveForce, and now it looks more fluid-like.
